_README: Fixtures for S-dashboard and its six states. One key per state name in
CANONICAL_STATES, plus `populated`.
EVERY NAME, TITLE AND COUNT IN HERE IS REAL. The screen names, file names,
photo titles, company names, project ids, bullet counts and category counts
are read out of data/home_config.json, data/portfolio_images.json,
data/resume.json and data/site_config.json. D-40's argument that build
phases must work against real text lengths collapses the moment a fixture is
invented, and this screen's whole job is to make a list of pending items
legible at its real width — which is a claim about real string lengths.
Verified against the manifests: 39 photos across 7 categories (architecture
14, nature 8, wildlife 5, abstract 4, street 4, portraits 2, product 2);
Brevo 11 bullets, PharmEasy 3, MAQ Software 4; 3 skill groups; 1 education
entry (VIT); 5 projects; 6 peekIds with 1 peekPosition set; 8 keys in
categoryColumns.
NOTHING NON-PUBLIC IS IN HERE. Every source file is already committed public
site content. No credential, token, D1 connection string or Cloudflare
Access value appears, and none is needed, because nothing in this plan
authenticates (T-00-29).
`marker` is the string check-states.mjs asserts is unique to each state. It
is deliberately a piece of the state's own AUTHORED COPY rather than a debug
token, so the gate cannot pass on a page that renders a marker without
rendering the state. `lastPublishedDaysAgo` is a number rather than an ISO
date so the fixture stays pure data and the page computes the instant.
